items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 21 at 1:14AM EST until November 22 at 4:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 4 to 6 feet in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Coastal Horry and Coastal Georgetown Counties.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 21 at 1:13AM EST until November 21 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 20 to 25
kt. For the Gale Warning, east winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts to
35 kt. Seas of 6 to 8 ft are expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Little River Inlet to Murrells
Inlet SC out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 9 AM EST this
morning. For the Gale Warning, from 9 AM this morning to 11 PM
EST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
